cover.note: The Chamber from the road: legislators with their ledgers wandering in and out, messengers running between them.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic photograph with the same camera, composition and building: the Chamber of Paxos, Hellenistic Greece, a round hall of pale marble under a low stone dome, ringed by a colonnade, open doorways all round its drum, on a wide paved terrace with marble statues on plinths. Replace every placeholder blob with real marble, statues and paving. Warm late-afternoon sun, deep blue sky. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its people and ledger exactly. In the foreground at right, the board's white-haired legislator stands writing in an open ledger like the board's while the board's young woman messenger hands him a small papyrus slip. Across the terrace a dozen more legislators in the same white himation with a broad purple border, each carrying a ledger, stroll in and out of the doorways alone or in twos; other messengers in blue run between them. No podium, no one addressing a crowd. Deep focus. No text, nothing modern.
